notes.title: Full Release - Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
In November Draginsanity will be fully released! Please note the following: I changed my mind and decided that achievements and saving the progress in the cloud do not necessarily need to be part of the first version of the full release. I still think they are potential ideas for updates and make a lot of sense. But you can still have an amazing experience without them when playing the game for the first time. I'd rather spend the time until the full release on improving the design and/or the look of all the stages. And of course I will add an awesome finale after the final boss fight.

Short update:
It took longer than I anticipated. But today I finally played the version of Draginsanity that I am happy to send into full release! My plan is to upload it in the next couple of days and to publish it over the weekend. Be prepared ;-)

notes.title: 6th update
notes.notes:
Finally: All 10 stages of Draginsanity are live! The last stage is available now. It doesn't introduce any new enemies or new mana. However, it combines almost everything from the past stages in a way that is truly insane!

The final boss is someone you know. Since stage 10 is the final stage it has to be the evil wizard. You're gonna fight him the first time at the end of stage 9. If you win he will retreat and transform. At the end of stage 10 you will fight him in his second form. He's gonna be much stronger! Can you beat again?

notes.title: 5th update
notes.notes:
Another stage can be played. The special thing about it is that there is barely any wind mana to make the hero dragon fly or hover mana to lift it up. Instead there is mana that let's the hero dragon spit... wind mana and hover mana! So first spit a lot of wind mana and hover mana and then use it to fly/hover over spikes and enemies!

Stage 4 also improved: The lava mana looks much better now and the boss fight was completely remastered.

Just to make sure that you'll find the new stage: It's the number 7. The former stages 7 and 8 are now 8 and 9.

notes.title: 4th update
notes.notes:
This update is not about new content. This time I beautified the already existing content:

* The hero had a complete makeover.
* The jumping dragons have a new mouth.
* The mana that lets you fly now looks different from the mana that lets you spit fire.
* The boss fights finally have a background.

Two bugfixes regarding the sound:

* The game over screen did not always play the correct sound.
* When pausing/leaving a stage the currently playing sounds sometimes didn't stop.

It's so exiting to see how much the game changed since I put it into early access. :-D

notes.title: Third Update
notes.notes:
In this new stage you will not be fighting a few dragons - you will be fighting an army of dragons! After you survive their first attack the music becomes more calming and lures you into safety. Don't be fooled - they will be back!

I placed the new stage before the last one and used the boss from stage 6 for it. Stage 6 got a new boss. I had the feeling that it fits better that way. What do you think?

notes.title: Second Update
notes.notes:
Finishing the second update took a few days longer than I expected but it sure was worth it! The game improved visually and it has some sound effects now! Here's what changed:

+ For the most part the mana fields are more than just colored rectangles.
+ Every stage has a background now, making the magical world Draginsanity more alive. (I'm planning to add backgrounds to the bossfights, too.)
+ The stages and bossfights have sound effects.

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Draginsanity has been in Early Access for one month now and I figured it is time for the first update. Last month I didn't have as much time as I usually have so there are only minor improvements:

+ Bosses now have a health bar so you can see how far you are from winning the boss fight.
+ The enemies don't just disappear after you hit them. They retreat. It kind of makes sense that the hero doesn't want to harm them because they are not really his enemy. Their minds are under the control of the evil wizard.
+ The Options "Try Again" and "Quit" appear later during the game over menu. Sometimes when I tested the game I lost while pressing the action button. The game restarted immediately because "Try Again" was selected. That was super annoying so I changed it.
